run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T07:23:26Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend-proxy is backed by real error spans from frontend-proxy itself: its 5m error-span rate rose from ~0.011/s at 07:23:00 to a peak of 1.222/s at 07:30:00 and was still 0.305/s at 07:40:00 (baseline ~0.008-0.018/s from 07:01 to 07:23). The dominant error path observed in traces is frontend-proxy ingress/egress HTTP 500 for POST /api/checkout, propagated from frontend POST /api/checkout -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (grpc 13) -> shipping /get-quote 500 -> shipping client span 'POST quote' failing with 'Timeout' after ~5.0s; checkout's span records the exact text 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500'. The quote service itself emitted no error spans and its request throughput fell to roughly one sixth of baseline (quote total span rate 2.06/s at 07:20 vs 0.345/s at 07:30), while its logs show 'Calculated quote' only in short bursts at second :15 of each minute - i.e. quote was reached mostly during the brief windows when the injected network chaos was recovered. Cluster events show a Chaos Mesh Schedule named otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition (namespace chaos-mesh) spawning a NetworkChaos every 60s from 07:23:20 onward, each 'Applied' to pods otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv and otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and recovered about 55s later. Shipping's 'POST quote' error series begins only after 07:23:20 (no error samples at the 07:23:00 evaluation), matching the chaos onset; all 21 otel-demo pods were Running/Ready with 0 restarts, endpoints exist for quote/email/shipping/frontend, and the flagd feature-flag ConfigMap has every flag on its 'off' default, so no pod-crash, scheduling, service-discovery or feature-flag fault matches the failure path. Conclusion is partial because the Schedule/NetworkChaos objects themselves are not readable with the allowed Kubernetes kinds - events are the only evidence for the injected fault - and because a second frontend-proxy failure mode (503 with no response from frontend) was observed but not tied to this cause.

claims.text: At 07:23:26 the frontend-proxy error-span rates were low: 0.0111 spans/s for span_name 'ingress' and 0 for span_name 'router frontend egress' (STATUS_CODE_ERROR), while STATUS_CODE_UNSET was ~10.2/s for both.

The frontend-proxy 5m error-span rate (sum over status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR) rose from 0.0111/s at the 07:23:00 evaluation to 0.0778/s at 07:24:00, 0.274/s at 07:25:00, 0.526/s at 07:26:00, peaked at 1.222/s at 07:30:00 and was 0.305/s at 07:40:00; from 07:01:00 to 07:23:00 the same series stayed between 0 and 0.0222/s.
At 07:30:00 the frontend-proxy ERROR rate was 0.611 spans/s on span_name 'ingress' and 0.611 spans/s on span_name 'router frontend egress', and the service total ERROR rate was 1.222 spans/s.

At 07:30:00 the services with ERROR span rates above zero were frontend 2.459/s, frontend-proxy 1.222/s, shipping 1.215/s and checkout 1.200/s; recommendation showed 0.0037/s. No other service appeared with a positive ERROR rate.

frontend-proxy's own error spans in the window are HTTP 500 with tag otel.status_code=ERROR on both span_name 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' (durations ~5.0-5.3 s), plus HTTP 503 ingress spans whose paired egress span carries http.status_code=0 and error='true'.

Whole-trace evidence shows the 500 path: load-generator POST 500 -> frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' 500 (5.16 s) -> frontend POST /api/checkout 500 -> frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (rpc.grpc.status_code=13) -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 13 -> checkout HTTP POST -> shipping /get-quote error 'Internal Server Error' (5.001 s) -> shipping 'POST quote' error 'Timeout' (5.001 s).
The exact error text recorded on checkout's PlaceOrder span and on frontend's /api/checkout span is 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500' (grpc 13 INTERNAL).

Baseline comparison for shipping's client span 'POST quote': from 07:01:00 to 07:23:00 the STATUS_CODE_UNSET rate was 0.62-0.76 spans/s and no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series appeared; from the 07:25:00 evaluation onward an ERROR series appeared at 0.13-0.58/s while the UNSET rate collapsed to ~0.115/s (0.0245/s at 07:39:00).

At 07:30:00 shipping span_name '/get-quote' and 'POST quote' each had ERROR 0.607/s and UNSET 0.115/s, while quote's spans ('POST /getquote', '{closure}', 'calculate-quote') carried only STATUS_CODE_UNSET at 0.1148/s each - no ERROR series for quote.

Comparing to baseline at 07:20:00 (before the fault), quote's total span rate was 2.056/s and email's was 2.741/s; at 07:30:00 quote's three spans summed to 0.345/s and email's spans to 0.459/s, i.e. throughput of both dropped by roughly 83%.

A successful request in the fault window (trace 1af1ccf908fd88b58ce95b2dff317f0f, 07:25:18) shows the normal wiring: shipping /get-quote 1.563 ms -> shipping 'POST quote' 1.436 ms -> quote 'POST /getquote' 281 us -> '{closure}' 173 us -> 'calculate-quote' 28 us, followed by email POST /send_order_confirmation 200 (81.7 ms); the whole checkout returned 200.

quote pod logs (quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w) in 07:22:27-07:33:15 contain only 'Calculated quote' lines, clustered at second :15 of each minute after 07:24, with a gap from 07:23:18 to 07:24:15 and no error lines; the newest 100 of 381 lines were shown.

Chaos Mesh events show NetworkChaos 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition-*' objects in namespace chaos-mesh with reason Applied and message 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv' and 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w' at 07:23:20, 07:24:20, 07:25:20 ... 07:32:20, each followed by reason TimeUp ('Time up according to the duration') and Recovered about 55 s later, e.g. Applied 07:23:20 -> TimeUp/Recovered 07:24:15.

A Chaos Mesh Schedule named otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition (namespace chaos-mesh) emitted reason Spawned every 60 s from 07:23:20 to 07:32:20, each message naming a newly created NetworkChaos object (e.g. 'Create new object: otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition-9xnx8').

Cluster-wide event grouping shows 20 NetworkChaos 'Applied', 18 'Recovered', 10 'Started', 9 'TimeUp' and 95 'Updated' events in namespace chaos-mesh, and 38 PodNetworkChaos 'Updated' events in namespace otel-demo, inside the incident window.

All 21 otel-demo pods, including quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w, shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv, email-59f69bc6cf-8z5c5, checkout-5dccddf8bb-pd7qk and frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-wvxht, were Running, ready, with restart count 0 at query time.

Endpoints objects exist with one pod address each for quote (100.96.1.165 -> quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w), email (100.96.2.193 -> email-59f69bc6cf-8z5c5), shipping (100.96.1.109 -> shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv) and frontend (100.96.4.107 -> frontend-675fd7b5c5-kgxrg), so the target Service objects resolve to the running pods.

The flagd-config ConfigMap's demo.flagd.json has every flag (adFailure, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc) on its 'off' defaultVariant, and contains no flag for shipping, quote or email network behavior.

The NetworkChaos partitions spawned every 60 s by the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition, applied to pods shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv and quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w from 07:23:20, are what makes shipping's 'POST quote' calls fail/timed out (5 s client timeout) while quote's server side shows no errors and receives requests mainly in the ~5 s per-minute windows after each Recovered event; this shipping-quote failure then propagates as checkout PlaceOrder 13, frontend 500 and frontend-proxy 500/RequestErrorRate.

The frontend-proxy 503 error spans (ingress 503, egress http.status_code=0, 183-799 ms, on GET operations such as user_index / user_view_cart / user_browse_product / user_get_recommendations between 07:29:57 and 07:34:44) are a second, possibly load-induced failure mode of the frontend-proxy->frontend hop and are not shown by the evidence to be caused by the shipping/quote network chaos.

quote and email were checked and showed no error status of their own: quote's 'POST /getquote', '{closure}' and 'calculate-quote' spans are all STATUS_CODE_UNSET at 0.1148/s each, email's 'POST /send_order_confirmation', 'send_email' and two 'sinatra.render_template' spans are all STATUS_CODE_UNSET (no ERROR series), and a sampled email span in the window returned http.status_code=200.

Other dependencies of the failing traces were checked in the sampled error traces and show success: checkout's calls to cart (POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart), currency (Currency/Convert, otel.status_code=OK) and product-catalog (oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct) return rpc.grpc.status_code=0, and payment's charge span returns rpc.grpc.status_code=0.

Rejected: a feature-flag-driven fault injection. flagd-config has all flags on 'off' defaults and none covers shipping/quote/email connectivity, so no flag setting matches the observed shipping-to-quote timeout path.

Rejected: pod crash, OOM, eviction or unschedulable capacity in otel-demo. All 21 pods were Running/Ready with 0 restarts, no pod events were recorded for otel-demo in the window (Pod events appeared only in namespace data-recorders), and no restart or termination reason was observed for quote, shipping, email, checkout or frontend pods.

Rejected: Service/Endpoints misconfiguration for the quote hop. The quote Service has a ready endpoint 100.96.1.165 pointing at pod quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w, and a successful shipping->quote call is recorded at 07:25:18 through the normal path, so the failure is intermittent rather than a missing endpoint.

Inspect the Chaos Mesh Schedule/NetworkChaos objects in namespace chaos-mesh (name prefix otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition) to read the exact partition selector, direction and duration, and decide whether the recurring experiment should keep running; no remediation was executed in this investigation.

Retrieve the definition of the RequestErrorRate alert rule from the Alertmanager/Prometheus rule files (it is not present in the queried Prometheus rule set) to confirm the exact expression behind the reported value 0.6444 for frontend-proxy.

gaps: The NetworkChaos and Schedule objects in namespace chaos-mesh cannot be read with the allowed Kubernetes kinds (networkchaos/schedule are not in the permitted list); only their events are available, so the partition's target selector, direction and exact parameters are unknown.

list_prometheus_rules returned no rules for rule_name RequestErrorRate and also no data for the unfiltered rule list, so the alert's exact PromQL expression and the source of the reported value 0.6444 are unknown.

A 1-minute error-rate query at 07:40:00 returned no data, so it is unknown when the frontend-proxy/shipping error series actually ended; the 5-minute view still showed 0.305/s at the 07:40:00 evaluation.
The networkpolicies query for namespace otel-demo returned no objects (no data), so the absence of static NetworkPolicies cannot be asserted as a fact.
The resourcequotas query for namespace otel-demo returned no objects (no data), so quota exhaustion is neither confirmed nor excluded by that query.
http_server_request_duration_seconds_count returned no series for the 07:25-07:30 window, so HTTP status-code level rates for frontend-proxy, quote and email are unavailable.
Pod log queries for frontend-675fd7b5c5-kgxrg and email-59f69bc6cf-8z5c5 returned no lines in 07:15-07:40, so their application logs could not be used.

The recorded error text names 'email service' ('failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500'), while the sampled successful wiring shows shipping calling quote (POST quote -> quote POST /getquote); what host the failing POST targets, and how it relates to the NetworkChaos name 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition', could not be verified from the readable evidence.
The cause of the frontend-proxy 503 error spans (egress http.status_code=0 on GET operations) is not established; whether it shares the shipping/quote network partition is unverified.

The time at which the chaos Schedule stopped is unknown: Schedule/NetworkChaos events were only returned up to 07:32:48, while frontend-proxy and shipping error rates were still positive at the 07:39:00/07:40:00 evaluations.
next_steps: Read the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition and one of its spawned NetworkChaos objects (CRD networkchaos.schedule/networkchaos.chaos-mesh.org) to record selector, target, direction and duration.
Fetch the RequestErrorRate rule definition from the Prometheus/Alertmanager rule source outside the queried rule set to confirm the alerting expression and the 0.6444 value.

Check whether the frontend-proxy 503s (egress http.status_code=0) coincide with frontend pod saturation caused by the 5 s checkout hangs, e.g. by comparing frontend CPU/concurrency and frontend-proxy 503 counts against chaos windows.
Confirm end-of-incident timing with a coarser error-rate query (e.g. 15-minute windows over 07:30-07:40) now that the 1-minute query returned no data.
